### Every day, our technology makes a** safer**,
### **sustainable **and more **productive ** world a reality.

**We do it by bringing together and investing in passionate, talented people.**

##### **As a leading global provider **of differentiated electronic instruments and
##### electromechanical devices, we are proud to solve some of the world’s most complex challenges.
##### Our strength comes from **four key areas**.

#### OUR NICHE MARKET FOCUS

### A combined vision for success

We target niche markets aligned with secular growth trends that provide multiple avenues of growth.

#### OUR GROWTH MODEL

### Designed to excel

The AMETEK Growth Model integrates Operational Excellence, New Product Development, Global and
Market Expansion, and Strategic Acquisitions with a focus on cash flow generation and disciplined
capital deployment.

#### OUR PEOPLE AND CULTURE

### United by bright prospects

We have a strong performance-driven and decentralized culture made of diverse high-performance teams
located across the globe that execute our strategy and embrace our values by doing the right thing
every day, in every interaction.

#### OUR PERFORMANCE

### Proud to be out in front

Our culture is to outperform. Over the past 15, 10, and 5-year periods we have substantially
outperformed the S&P 500 index and the S&P Industrials. We deliver double-digit earnings over the
business cycle.

### **Explore** our products

##### **Life is full of complex challenges****.** Each one inspires us to do what we love. To make
##### the world a better place. Not just with our differentiated technologies that improve countless
##### lives, but by **empowering our people to inspire others** across the globe.

AMETEK CONSISTS OF TWO DIFFERENTIATED OPERATING GROUPS

## Our electronic instruments

AMETEK is a worldwide leader in the design and manufacturing of advanced analytical, test and
measurement instrumentation for the energy, aerospace, power, research, medical and industrial
markets.
BOTH OPERATING GROUPS OCCUPY LEADING POSITIONS IN NICHE MARKETS

## Our electromechanical devices

We are world-renowned as a differentiated supplier of automation and precision motion control
solutions, and highly engineered electrical interconnects, specialty metals and thermal management
systems.

### Why choose Tinius Olsen?

Tinius Olsen himself invented the first universal testing machine in 1880 and, throughout its
history, the company has been at the forefront of development and innovation. Whether you are
looking for a single testing machine or a fully automated system that runs 24 hours a day, 365 days
a year, you can be sure that every element has been designed and tested to the highest Tinius Olsen
standards.

### Productivity, Repeatability, Traceability

Tinius Olsen offers solutions for testing the strength and performance of plastics, metals,
composites and many other materials through tensile, flexural, compression, folding endurance,
impact, heat distortion, Vicat, melt flow, tear and puncture tests. Our versatile testing machines
can perform tests in accordance with ASTM, ISO and other international standards from test
configuration through to reporting and generating results immediately for your processes.

[[arrow-icon] More][50]
[productivity-img]

## Featured Products

### Automated Systems

[horizon]

Tinius Olsen has developed scalable technology blocks to automate tensile, compression, flexural,
impact, melt flow and hardness tests. Capable of testing up to 1000+ specimens in a 24-hour period,
saving time and making money.

[ [arrow-icon] More][51]

### VectorExtensometer

[epsilon]

**The Future of Extensometry**
Tinius Olsen introduces Vector a step change in extensometer technology capable of replacing
multiple contacting and non-contacting sensors with a single, industry specific instrument.
Integrating adaptive AI capabilities with optical hardware, Vector reduces test throughput times and
complexity, automating the process of capturing strain, improving measurement accuracy, data
consistency and operator safety.

[ [arrow-icon] More][52]

### Horizon Software

[featured-img]

Horizon makes all your testing as effortless as it should be. It helps you meet your R&D and quality
control needs, working simply, efficiently and accurately to carry out your testing, presenting
visible data in real time. You can use it on multiple machines and PCs so that programs and data can
be shared across your network, while maintaining security and data integrity throughout.

[ [arrow-icon] More][53]

complexity, automating the process of capturing strain, improving measurement accuracy, data
consistency and operator safety.

# AeroNordic – Independent Test Laboratory for Composite Materials

AeroNordic is an independent, Danish test laboratory and engineering company specialising in
composite materials and wind turbine blades. We offer specimen manufacturing, material testing, and
engineering support – all under one roof and in full compliance with international ISO and ASTM
standards.

We work with customers in more than 24 countries and have performed over 1,600 material tests and
manufactured more than 3,500 test specimens. Our customers include leading companies in the wind
energy and composite materials industry, including Ørsted.

Our most in-demand services:
– Rain Erosion Testing (DNVGL-RP-0171)
– Accelerated Artificial Weathering (ISO 12944)
– Fatigue Testing (ISO 13001 / ASTM D3479)
– Specimen Manufacturing for Leading Edge Protection (LEP)
– DNVGL-RP-0573 LEP Screening & Full Qualification

We are located near motorway E45 in Horsens, Denmark.

# We Make Fencing Possible


Excitement, passion and pulsating energy, felt in every movement, in every hit, in every cry of
victory. Fencing is precision, endurance, discipline and pure emotion. As the No. 1 in fencing, we
don't just understand the world of fencing - we live it. We turn dreams into aspirations by
equipping fencers of every generation with everything they need - high-quality and innovative
fencing equipment, from weapons to fencing socks. We offer our fencing community in over 160
countries allstar products renowned for highest quality and best performance. In short: We make
fencing possible. 

 As a family-run global player in its 4th generation, we have been living the passion for this
unique sport for six decades. We are pioneers, constantly evolving and driven by an unwavering
spirit of innovation. The needs and safety of our athletes are always our top priority. They
motivate us to give our best every day.

# We Make Fencing Possible


Excitement, passion and pulsating energy, felt in every movement, in every hit, in every cry of
victory. Fencing is precision, endurance, discipline and pure emotion. As the No. 1 in fencing, we
don't just understand the world of fencing - we live it. We turn dreams into aspirations by
equipping fencers of every generation with everything they need - high-quality and innovative
fencing equipment, from weapons to fencing socks. We offer our fencing community in over 160
countries allstar products renowned for highest quality and best performance. In short: We make
fencing possible. 

 As a family-run global player in its 4th generation, we have been living the passion for this
unique sport for six decades. We are pioneers, constantly evolving and driven by an unwavering
spirit of innovation. The needs and safety of our athletes are always our top priority. They
motivate us to give our best every day.

increase overall productivity.

Akona’s weighing and batching systems are built to deliver precise measurement and controlled
material flow for materials being handled. They automate the batching process to improve
consistency, reduce cycle times and eliminate manual errors. Engineered for reliability and
integration, these systems help customers streamline operations, maintain process accuracy and
increase overall productivity.

 

[ Weighing and Batching ][60]

## 03 Ingredient Handling

Our ingredient handling systems are designed to deliver the exact ingredients needed, safely and
efficiently. From storage to transfer, they ensure precise, hygienic delivery and seamless
integration with your process.

 

[ Ingredient Handling ][61]

## 04 Semi-Automated Filling

Akona’s semi-automated bulk bag filling solutions combine precision and ease of use to deliver
consistent, high-efficiency packaging. Designed to reduce manual handling, these systems help scale
your operations while improving throughput and accuracy.

 

[ Semi-Automated Filling ][62]

About Us
**About Us**

**Apan Enterprise **initiated its operations to draw benefits from the emerging needs of branded,
high performing and reliable products on the global platform. 

Throughout our years of foundation, we have worked hard to become an approved and authorized dealer
for marketing and sailing technology based global brands like **Aimil Ltd., Elcometer Ltd., MBH
Analytical Ltd., Endecotts Ltd., Glen Creston Ltd.** With our efforts and pragmatic business
approach, we have been able to meet and exceed our clients expectations. 

Our main objective is to achieve customer satisfaction and we always seek to achieve it by making
sure that our products are thoroughly tested and evaluated during the research and development phase
and very rigorously tested before shipping to any of our customers.

Core team of Apan Enterprise have 19 years business development experience & dedicated to providing
the best product in value, performance and reliability.

**Our Product Portfolio**

We are trader and supplier of the following products:

* **Analytical Instrument**
* **Material Testing Equipment**
* **Surface Profile Gauge**
* **Color, Gloss, Haze Test and Measurement Equipment**
* **Coating Thickness Gauge**
* **Adhesion Tester**
* **Pinhole and Porosity Detector**
* **NDT Testing Instruments**
* **Test Sieve**
* **Sieve Shaker**
* **Ultrasonic Cleaner**
* **Fluid Bed Dryer**
* **Chemical Standard Certified Reference Materials**
* **MBH Analytical**

## Σχετικά με Εμάς

Η ιστορία της Ν. Αστεριάδης Α.Ε. ξεκινά το 1955, όταν ο Νικόλαος Αστεριάδης ιδρύει την τότε
«ΝΙΚΟΛΑΟΣ ΑΣΤΕΡΙΑΔΗΣ» στη Θεσσαλονίκη – μια μικρή επιχείρηση με μεγάλο όραμα: να φέρει στην Ελλάδα
την τεχνολογική πρόοδο μέσα από την επιστημονική και βιομηχανική καινοτομία. Ένα όραμα που
εξελίχθηκε, επεκτάθηκε και σταθεροποιήθηκε το 1985 με τη σύσταση της σημερινής εταιρικής μορφής. 

Αρχικά δραστηριοποιούμενη ως αντιπρόσωπος εταιρειών επιστημονικών οργάνων της Αθήνας στη Βόρεια
Ελλάδα, η εταιρεία δεν άργησε να χαράξει τη δική της αυτόνομη πορεία. Σημαντικοί σταθμοί ήταν η
συνεργασία με την Eppendorf, καθώς και η αποκλειστική διάθεση των μικροσκοπίων ZEISS στη Βόρεια
Ελλάδα. Από τα μέσα της δεκαετίας του ’60, διευρύνει τις δραστηριότητές της στον τομέα του
επαγγελματικού ήχου και της εμπορίας ηλεκτρονικών εξαρτημάτων, ενώ το 1967 αποκτά παρουσία και στην
Αθήνα με νέο υποκατάστημα. 

Το 1973, η συνεργασία με τη JEOL καθιστά την εταιρεία πρωτοπόρο στον τομέα της Ηλεκτρονικής
Μικροσκοπίας, ενώ η στρατηγική συμμαχία με τη SHIMADZU το 1978 δίνει νέα ώθηση στην αγορά των
Αναλυτικών Οργάνων.

Η ιστορία της Ν. Αστεριάδης Α.Ε. ξεκινά το 1955, όταν ο Νικόλαος Αστεριάδης ιδρύει την τότε
«ΝΙΚΟΛΑΟΣ ΑΣΤΕΡΙΑΔΗΣ» στη Θεσσαλονίκη – μια μικρή επιχείρηση με μεγάλο όραμα: να φέρει στην Ελλάδα
την τεχνολογική πρόοδο μέσα από την επιστημονική και βιομηχανική καινοτομία. Ένα όραμα που
εξελίχθηκε, επεκτάθηκε και σταθεροποιήθηκε το 1985 με τη σύσταση της σημερινής εταιρικής μορφής. 

Αρχικά δραστηριοποιούμενη ως αντιπρόσωπος εταιρειών επιστημονικών οργάνων της Αθήνας στη Βόρεια
Ελλάδα, η εταιρεία δεν άργησε να χαράξει τη δική της αυτόνομη πορεία. Σημαντικοί σταθμοί ήταν η
συνεργασία με την Eppendorf, καθώς και η αποκλειστική διάθεση των μικροσκοπίων ZEISS στη Βόρεια
Ελλάδα. Από τα μέσα της δεκαετίας του ’60, διευρύνει τις δραστηριότητές της στον τομέα του
επαγγελματικού ήχου και της εμπορίας ηλεκτρονικών εξαρτημάτων, ενώ το 1967 αποκτά παρουσία και στην
Αθήνα με νέο υποκατάστημα. 

Το 1973, η συνεργασία με τη JEOL καθιστά την εταιρεία πρωτοπόρο στον τομέα της Ηλεκτρονικής
Μικροσκοπίας, ενώ η στρατηγική συμμαχία με τη SHIMADZU το 1978 δίνει νέα ώθηση στην αγορά των
Αναλυτικών Οργάνων.

## Frequently Asked Questions

How do I pay for the Philippines company reports?
You can buy reports with a credit card:
1. [Search][22] for a company and add reports to your cart.
2. Go to [Checkout][23] and pay by card.
3. Your reports will be emailed after payment.
How fast do I get a Philippines company report?
Most reports are delivered within one business day. You will see the expected timeline on the
checkout page.
What if I can’t find a Philippine company?
Click "I can't find a company" under the search bar and our support team can check manually with SEC
records.
Why haven't I received the report I purchased?
It could be due to:
1. **Processing time** – Some reports take longer; delivery time is shown at checkout.
2. **Spam folder** – Check your spam/junk mail.
3. **Public holiday** – We may be waiting on updated data.

Still unsure? [Contact us here][24] and we'll help you quickly.

I made a duplicate order.
Ordered the same report more than once? Let us know and we’ll refund the duplicate or offer another
report.
Can I use your reports for cross-border due diligence?
Yes, our reports come from authoritative sources and are widely accepted for KYC, compliance, and
international due diligence.
How do I remove my company from Companies House?
We don’t manually add or remove companies — we use government datasets. You can add more info to
your page or let us know if your company is dissolved or renamed.

Construction Testing Solutions

**Established in 2006, CTS (Construction Testing Solutions) are now proudly part of the Phenna
Group, Infrastructure Division.**

Supporting all sectors of the UK construction market including commercial, rail, roads, airports,
tunnelling, mining, utilities and residential as well as brownfield regeneration, our market leading
services, along with our technical knowledge and expertise is what sets us apart from the rest. 

At CTS we work collaboratively with clients throughout the whole project lifecycle offering a
comprehensive and bespoke construction testing service package, working alongside you as your
partner providing a more personalised approach.

Our network of laboratories and field-based teams provides coverage across the whole of the UK. This
allows us to offer an extensive range of soil, aggregate, concrete and bituminous materials testing.
Other services include full chemical analysis, site investigation, structural investigation,
calibration services and more.

consistent performance in your demanding industrial or research environment.

your sustainability goals.

## Why experts trust our digital dentistry solutions
* #### Faster workflows, improved proficiency
  
  Save time by working with high-performance software that runs robustly, even when dealing with
  large and complex cases. Quick response times and optimal usability help speed up your daily work.
* #### It’s easy to use and to reach your high expectations
  
  Your complex procedures can become more simple and efficient, thanks to our experience working
  closely with dental professionals like yourself, creating more accessible dental software for the
  digital age.
* #### Flexibility as you require it
  
  Experience maximum flexibility and freedom through exocad’s modular and open approach. It’s not
  just the software that is flexible, the business model is too. Mix and match modules, buy
  perpetual CAD software licenses, or rent the software at attractive rates – it’s all your choice.
* #### Reliability you can trust
  
  You can rely on us to create software that you will continue to appreciate and profit from. Our
  product has proven its stability time and time again, because we always pay the greatest attention
  to quality and to detail. Our reliable updates provide new possibilities that are always driven by
  your needs.
* #### Independent & innovative
  
  Our software puts you at the forefront of innovation. Since our foundation in 2010, our dedicated
  team of engineers and researchers has consistently developed state-of-the-art innovations for the
  dental industry. As the independent and hardware-neutral technology provider, our goal is to push
  the limits of digital dentistry through software solutions.
* #### Truly future-proof
  
  We’re the dental CAD/CAM software provider with the widest choice of integrated solutions using
  third-party scanners, mills, printers, and materials. And we are always open to new ideas, ready
  to support today’s and tomorrow’s best solutions to meet and exceed our customers’ requirements.

scroll through the version timeline.[
Explore features][30]
[Built for how communities actually work illustration]

#### Built for how communities actually work

From hackathons and research groups to open-source projects, study groups, and devnets, HackMD has
been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes
* [Shared workspaces][31]
* [Embeds][32]
* [Slide mode][33]
* Open-source friendly
When your community has a home base where anyone can show up, share what they know, and start
building with each other, that's when things start to take off. HackMD gives your community a place
to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten
contributors or ten thousand.[
See community stories][34]
[Markdown your team writes illustration]

#### Give your agents the context they need, without the overhead

Every HackMD note is Markdown all the way down, which means your agents can pull context, reference
docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.
* Pull any note as Markdown via REST API or CLI
* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace
* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown

# Home

### The lead authority in industrial rope access

Industrial rope access has been developed by IRATA International for over 38 years to a point where
it is the chosen means of access for much of the work in the offshore oil and gas industry as well
as a range of projects in construction, civil engineering, the built and natural environment and
much more. Its success is based on thorough training and strict work guidelines that deliver an
unrivalled safe working record year after year. The environmental, efficiency and economic benefits
have resulted in growing international support for industrial rope access ahead of alternative means
of access.

### The lead authority in industrial rope access

Industrial rope access has been developed by IRATA International for over 38 years to a point where
it is the chosen means of access for much of the work in the offshore oil and gas industry as well
as a range of projects in construction, civil engineering, the built and natural environment and
much more. Its success is based on thorough training and strict work guidelines that deliver an
unrivalled safe working record year after year. The environmental, efficiency and economic benefits
have resulted in growing international support for industrial rope access ahead of alternative means
of access.

Advanced Fiber Optic Measurement and Monitoring Systems
[Scroll  ][62]
Application Spotlight: Structural Health Monitoring with Fiber Optic Sensors

## Building Smarter and Safer Infrastructure

Fiber optic sensors enable accurate and dependable structural health monitoring systems that can
span all sizes of structures and capture both static and dynamic phenomenon. Luna's monitoring
system instrumentation includes optical interrogators, long-gage strain sensors, accelerometers,
temperature sensors and tilt meters for crucial structural integrity measurements. 

[Learn More][63]

#  Enabling the Future with Fiber 

Advanced Fiber Optic Measurement and Monitoring Systems
[Scroll  ][66]
Application Spotlight: Fiber Optic Sensors Improve Material Joining

## Measurements for the Lightweighting Revolution

Widespread automotive lightweighting requires more reliable bonding and joining of composite
materials. In-situ monitoring based on high-definition distributed fiber optic sensors is being used
to provide real-time data to optimize and verify the joining processes.

 

 

[Learn More][67]

#  Enabling the Future with Fiber 

[Scroll  ][68]
Application Spotlight: Tire Calendering

## Better Quality, Improved Safety, and Lower Costs for Tire Manufacturers

For products with fabric cords, the ability to make online balance measurements has not been
available - until now. Luna's terahertz sensor-- using reflections of an emitted energy pulse -- can
provide safe, fast, accurate thickness measurements and simultaneously assess the balance of ply
constructions.

[Learn More][69]

* Increase Brand Relevance

  over time, turning resonance into lasting competitive advantage.

  strategies that turn unfamiliar ground into profitable terrain.

  surprise, delight and meaning that competitors simply cannot replicate.
* Increase Customer Lifetime Value
  
  Deepen relationships. We help you unlock the full potential of every customer relationship,
  maximizing long-term value through loyalty, retention and meaningful connection.

#### What Is Non Destructive Testing?

Non Destructive Testing (NDT) is the process of inspecting, testing, or evaluating materials,
components or assemblies for discontinuities, or differences in characteristics without destroying
the serviceability of the part or system. In other words, when the inspection or test is completed
the part can still be used

## News

Non Destructive Testers Limited (NDTL) is a pioneer in the region in Inspections and Non Destructive
Testing. Established in 1990, NDTL provides a range of inspection, testing and heat treatment
services to the petroleum, petrochemical and other energy related downstream industries. Its'
headquarters is strategically located in South Trinidad.



The company is staffed by a team of highly experienced and certified professionals. Their competence
is matched by NDTL's investment in technology and quality tools and equipment. NDTL is constantly
training and certifying its staff and has a rigorous maintenance program for testing and calibrating
its tool and equipment. All this is in keeping with its objective of satisfying their valued
customers each and every time.

# Open-Source Infrastructure as Code

OpenTofu is a reliable, flexible, community-driven infrastructure as code tool under the Linux
Foundation's stewardship. It serves as a **drop-in replacement for Terraform**, preserving your
existing workflows and configurations.

With a thriving ecosystem of **3,900+ providers** and **23,600+ modules**, you can build and manage
infrastructure across every cloud platform with confidence.

[Get Started][39][View on GitHub][40]

### Create an S3 Bucket

Define your infrastructure as code with OpenTofu. A few lines of configuration is all you need to
create and manage cloud resources with confidence.

main.tf

`
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = "us-west-1"
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket" "example" {
  bucket = "my-example-bucket"
}
`

### Configure DNS Records

Version control your infrastructure with OpenTofu. Track changes, collaborate with your team, and
deploy DNS configurations with a single command.

main.tf

`
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cloudflare = {
      source  = "cloudflare/cloudflare"
      version = "~> 4.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "cloudflare" {
  api_token = var.cloudflare_api_token
}

resource "cloudflare_record" "example" {
  zone_id = "0da42c8d2132a9ddaf714f9e7c920711"
  name    = "www"
  value   = "192.0.2.1"
  type    = "A"
  ttl     = 3600
  proxied = true
}
`

### Set Up GitHub Repositories

Automate your development workflow with OpenTofu. Create repositories, set up branch protection, and
manage team access in code.

main.tf

`
terraform {
  required_providers {
    github = {
      source  = "integrations/github"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "github" {
  token = var.github_token
}

resource "github_repository" "example" {
  name        = "my-repo"
  description = "My application repository"
  visibility  = "public"
  auto_init   = true
}

resource "github_branch_protection" "main" {
  repository_id  = github_repository.example.id
  pattern        = "main"
  enforce_admins = true
}
`

## Features Unique to OpenTofu

Powerful capabilities — built by the community to solve real-world challenges in infrastructure
management

/bin/bash

`
# Command line usage
$ tofu plan -exclude="aws_instance.database"
$ tofu apply -exclude="module.network"

# Exclude multiple resources
$ tofu apply \
  -exclude="aws_instance.web[0]" \
  -exclude="aws_instance.web[1]"
`

### Exclusion Flag

[v1.9][41]

Selectively exclude resources from operations with the -exclude flag. This provides more control
during testing and rollouts, allowing you to focus on specific parts of your infrastructure.

[Learn more][42]
main.tf

`
# Define regions for deployment
variable "regions" {
  type    = set(string)
  default = ["us-west-1", "us-east-1", "eu-west-1"]
}

variable "disabled_regions" {
  type    = set(string)
  default = []
}

# Create provider for each region
provider "aws" {
  alias    = "by_region"
  region   = each.value
  for_each = var.regions
}

# Deploy resources in each active region
module "deploy" {
  source    = "./deploy"
  providers = {
    aws = aws.by_region[each.key]
  }
  for_each = setsubtract(var.regions, var.disabled_regions)
}
`

### Provider Iteration with for_each

[v1.9][43]

Dynamically generate provider configurations with for_each, eliminating repetitive code and
improving maintainability. Perfect for multi-region deployments, multi-environment setups
(dev/staging/prod), multi-account scenarios, and cross-cloud implementations. Provider for_each
enables cleaner infrastructure patterns, simplified credential rotation, and more controlled
progressive rollouts across your infrastructure landscape.

[Learn more][44]
main.tf

`
# Define module version as a variable
variable "aws_module_version" {
  description = "Version of AWS modules to use"
  type        = string
  default     = "5.6.1"
}

# Use the variable for module versioning
module "vpc" {
  source  = "terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws"
  version = var.aws_module_version
  name = "my-vpc"
  cidr = "10.0.0.0/16"
  azs             = ["us-west-2a", "us-west-2b"]
  private_subnets = ["10.0.1.0/24", "10.0.2.0/24"]
  public_subnets  = ["10.0.101.0/24", "10.0.102.0/24"]
}
`

[][6]

## SERVICES

###### Geotechnical Consulting

P.A. & Associates provides a full range of Geotechnical Engineering services including but not
limited to:
* Subsurface Exploration
* Laboratory Testing of soil, rock, and geosynthetic materials
* Engineering Analysis
* Recommendations for design and construction of Foundations, Earthworks, Pavement Sections, Shoring
  and Bracing, Retaining Walls, Slopes, Subgrade Improvements, Groundwater Control

###### Environmental Engineering

P.A. & Associates offers specialized Environmental Engineering services including but not limited
to:
* Environmental Site Assessment
* Groundwater Investigation
* Environmental Monitoring Programs
* Site Remediation of Soil, Groundwater, and Building Components
* Biophysical Studies
* Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plans
* Environmental Risk and Impact Assessments 
* Sampling of Environmental Media for chemical analysis

###### Material Testing & Inspection

P.A. & Associates caters to all material testing and material inspection needs.

Special Inspections available for:
* Reinforced Concrete
* Structural Masonry
* Pre-Stressed Concrete
* Structural Welding
* Spray-Applied Fireproofing
* Structural Bolts

Material Tests include:
* Masonry Prisms & Cubes
* Concrete Strength 
* Grout/Mortar
* Shotcrete
* Field and Plant Concrete/Asphalt


SERVICES

## ABOUT

P.A. & Associates, Inc., is a Geotechnical Engineering, Environmental, and Material Inspection
Consulting company that has been in operation since 1991. Our company offers a full range of
services such as Geotechnical and Environmental Engineering Consulting, Material Testing and
Inspection. We specialize in providing preventive measures and cost effective solutions to
engineering & environmental problems related to soil, geologic, material testing and inspection.
P.A. & Associates takes pride in achieving client satisfaction through quality performance.

# ABOUT

Russell Technologies India Pvt. Ltd. (RTI), Lucknow, India, is an associate of Russell NDE Systems
Inc. (RNSI) for operations in India and adjoining countries. We have a group of highly qualified and
dedicated engineers who provide specialized NDT expertise to customers in the oil & gas, electricity
& power, chemical & fertilizer, municipal, and other industries.

#### Non Destructive Testing (NDT) Equipment

With over 50 years of NDT industry experience, we offer in-house and onsite training courses. Our

about the company

TECHNONICOL Corporation is a leading international producer of reliable and effective building
materials and systems. The company offers innovative products and technologies that combine
solutions of proper research centers and international experience.

The Corporation includes two large divisions, independently managed by each of the owners: the
TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, and the Trading Company "Technonicol
Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov.

The TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, integrates 70+ production sites in
Russia and abroad, 19 training centers and 7 research centers equipped with high-tech equipment and
qualified personnel. The centers regularly develop and implement new products and solutions for the
construction industry.

Trading Company "Technonicol Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov specializes in selling the
Corporation's products, but also other building materials and tools for industrial, civil and
private housing construction in more than 100 trade offices in Russia and the CIS.

The mission of TECHNONICOL is to produce high quality, reliable and effective construction materials
and solutions, which we strive to make available to every person in the world. Our team is guided by
principles of workmanship, high professionalism, responsibility and safety.

We are passionate about constant perfection of our materials, challenge met by our Research and
development centers. The company is constantly upgrading existing technologies and launching new
materials. Our Research centers and laboratories possess modern equipment to study physical and
mechanical properties of materials within a wide range of temperatures, define the structure and
ingredients of raw compounds and test the durability of finished products. Scientific research and
new technologies make it possible to launch several new products every year.

TECHNONICOL is among the first Russian companies to emphasize the need of educating builders in new
technologies and innovative material application. Our training centers offer modern equipment,
stands, models and spaces for hands-on training. Thanks to practical approach to learning, we give
additional educational support to our employees, customers and partners.

collaboration drives our team. We seek lively and mutually beneficial partnerships with other

## FAQ

## What is TOEFL?

TOEFL, or Test of English as a Foreign Language, measures the English language proficiency of
non-native speakers. It is commonly used for university admissions and other academic placements.

## How is the TOEFL scored?

The TOEFL is scored on a scale of 0 to 120 points, divided equally among four sections: Reading,
Listening, Speaking, and Writing. Each section is worth 30 points.

## What is a good TOEFL score?

A good TOEFL score depends on the requirements of the institution you are applying to. Generally,
scores above 90 are considered good, while top universities may require scores above 100.

## How long is the TOEFL test?

The TOEFL test takes about 3 hours to complete, including check-in time. Each section is timed
separately.

## How do I register for the TOEFL?

You can register for the TOEFL test online through the official ETS website. You will need to create
an account, choose a test date and location, and pay the registration fee.

## What should I bring to the test center?

On the test day, bring a valid ID (such as a passport), your registration confirmation, and a few
pencils and erasers. Personal items like bags and mobile phones are usually not allowed in the
testing room.

On the test day, bring a valid ID (such as a passport), your registration confirmation, and a few
pencils and erasers. Personal items like bags and mobile phones are usually not allowed in the

## What is TOEFL?

non-native speakers. It is commonly used for university admissions and other academic placements.

## How is the TOEFL scored?

The TOEFL is scored on a scale of 0 to 120 points, divided equally among four sections: Reading,
Listening, Speaking, and Writing. Each section is worth 30 points.

## What is a good TOEFL score?

A good TOEFL score depends on the requirements of the institution you are applying to. Generally,
scores above 90 are considered good, while top universities may require scores above 100.

## How long is the TOEFL test?

The TOEFL test takes about 3 hours to complete, including check-in time. Each section is timed
separately.

an account, choose a test date and location, and pay the registration fee.

## Не угробь
## 20 лет жизни

Я видел десятки, сотни парней, которые угробили свою жизнь, выбрав не ту. Пока брака нет - все
кажется таким несерьезным, легко сойтись и легко разойтись, но после брака так уже не получится,
это: годы, десятки лет жизни, имущество, дети без отца. Это страшно.

Современная норма 18-25 летней сейчас выглядит так: выращенная матерью одиночкой, воспитана тиктоком
и его ценностями: *«сильная и независимая, мены - не нужны, карьера важнее семьи, не хочу детей»* -
это совсем не то, что было во времена наших родителей, бабушек и дедушек. А критерии парней сейчас:
*«ну, чтобы красивая была...»*. Поэтому **Росстат: 7-8 разводов на 10 браков, у меня в базе: 9 из 10
девушек - в D. Институт семьи - в дерьме.** И парней тут не за что винить, ибо выбирать партнера
нигде не учат.

Поэтому я и сделал тест, аналогов которому - сейчас нет. Бесплатно, потому что энтузиаст, не бизнес.
Чтобы парень мог увидеть, кто перед ним, пока не стало поздно.

Дальше - твое решение.

## 20 лет жизни

Я видел десятки, сотни парней, которые угробили свою жизнь, выбрав не ту. Пока брака нет - все
кажется таким несерьезным, легко сойтись и легко разойтись, но после брака так уже не получится,
это: годы, десятки лет жизни, имущество, дети без отца. Это страшно.

Современная норма 18-25 летней сейчас выглядит так: выращенная матерью одиночкой, воспитана тиктоком
и его ценностями: *«сильная и независимая, мены - не нужны, карьера важнее семьи, не хочу детей»* -
это совсем не то, что было во времена наших родителей, бабушек и дедушек. А критерии парней сейчас:
*«ну, чтобы красивая была...»*. Поэтому **Росстат: 7-8 разводов на 10 браков, у меня в базе: 9 из 10
девушек - в D. Институт семьи - в дерьме.** И парней тут не за что винить, ибо выбирать партнера
нигде не учат.

Чтобы парень мог увидеть, кто перед ним, пока не стало поздно.
